title: Exceptionally Stable and Hollow Tubular Metal-Orga
one_line_summary: Design rule: heat as-synthesized [ZnF(AmTAZ)]·solvent to 800 °C under He

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [neutral] heat as-synthesized [ZnF(AmTAZ)]·solvent to 800 °C under He → decomposition product changes from ZnO in air to ZnCN2 in He

key_insights.title: Comparison
key_insights.body: product from heating as-synthesized [ZnF(AmTAZ)]·solvent to 800 °C in He vs product from heating as-synthesized [ZnF(AmTAZ)]·solvent to 800 °C in air: winner=tie on decomposition_product_phase

key_insights.title: Comparison
key_insights.body: product from heating as-synthesized [ZnF(AmTAZ)]·solvent to 800 °C in He with trace O2 vs product from heating as-synthesized [ZnF(AmTAZ)]·solvent to 800 °C in He: winner=subject_b on phase_purity_of_decomposition_product

key_insights.title: Failure
key_insights.body: [performance_regression] heat as-synthesized [ZnF(AmTAZ)]·solvent to 800 °C in He containing trace O2: a mixed ZnCN2-ZnO product forms instead of phase-pure ZnCN2

notable_quotes: Under He at 800 °C, the product is ZnCN2, whereas under air at 800 °C the product is ZnO, showing atmosphere-dependent decomposition.
Heating the as-synthesized compound to 800 °C in N2 produces ZnCN2, with a powder XRD pattern matching the simulated ZnCN2 pattern.
Trace O2 in He at 800 °C gives a mixed ZnCN2-ZnO product rather than phase-pure ZnCN2, indicating oxygen sensitivity of the conversion.
